style.prompt: A bright, punchy 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge, designed to read instantly on a phone. On the RIGHT half: a huge close-up face of an entirely invented adult gamer, eyes wide open, eyebrows raised, mouth open in an exaggerated shocked expression, expressive and photorealistic, dramatic vibrant lighting, bold white cutout outline and electric cyan rim light. On the LEFT half: the exact three words "ONE LAST TRY", stacked in three large lines ONE / LAST / TRY, thick ultra-bold condensed sans-serif typography, yellow and white letters with very thick dark outline and punchy drop shadow, perfectly legible, filling the left side without touching edges. Background: vivid electric blue and purple gaming arena with hot pink and orange bursts, abstract neon obstacles, dynamic speed lines and a few sparks, slightly blurred to keep focus on the face and words. High contrast, saturated colors, polished professional gaming thumbnail composition. Keep face and lettering separated, no overlap, generous safe margins. No other text, no logos, no watermarks.
